notes: Collected the GSAS terminal master's programmes (as listed on the GSAS programs page) plus SOM, Environment, Jackson, Law, Architecture, Music, Drama, Art and Nursing. GSAS values come from the graduate-school pages (international guidance, dates and deadlines) and each programme page; the GSAS publishes no TOEFL/IELTS minimum. Skipped: Public Health MPH (robots.txt), Master of Environmental Science/Forest Science and M.E.D. (thesis research degrees), SOM Technology Management (Yale College students only) and Public Education Management (US school-system leaders), MN and Hybrid MSN (cannot enroll F-1/J-1 students). Deadlines are recorded only where the page states day, month and year; YSE, Music, Law, Jackson and Systemic Risk deadlines lack a year and were left out. The SOM Global Business and Society page still says the Class of 2027 application opens in September 2025 while its round table shows 2026-27 dates. MAM and GBS round dates sit in a table; each date is labelled by its position. No Chinese-degree-specific page exists.
